cases.explain: The transitive verb благословите (bless) governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Все слуги ___, стоящие ночью в доме Господнем.
cases.explain: The possessive genitive is used with слуги (servants) to show they belong to the Lord.
The preposition в (in) with the location meaning governs the prepositional case.
Руки is the direct object of the transitive verb вознесите (lift up), taking the accusative case.
The preposition в (in) before the location of the sanctuary governs the prepositional case.
The verb благословите (bless) takes a direct object in the accusative case.
Небо is the direct object of the transitive verb сотворивший (made), taking the accusative case.
Сион is used as the subject in a shortened form, taking the nominative case.

reading.ru: Благословите Господа все слуги Господни, стоящие ночью в доме Господнем.
reading.question: Who is called to bless the Lord?
options: All servants of the Lord standing in the temple at night
reading.correct: All servants of the Lord standing in the temple at night
reading.explain: The text invites 'все слуги Господни, стоящие ночью в доме Господнем' (all servants of the Lord standing at night in the house of the Lord) to bless Him.

reading.ru: Вознесите руки свои в святилище и благословите Господа.
reading.question: What gesture accompanies the blessing?
options: Lifting up hands in the sanctuary
reading.correct: Lifting up hands in the sanctuary
reading.explain: The command is 'Вознесите руки свои в святилище и благословите Господа' (Lift up your hands in the sanctuary and bless the Lord).

reading.ru: Господь, сотворивший небо и землю, да благословит тебя Сиона.
reading.question: Who is invoked to give the blessing?
options: The Lord who created heaven and earth
reading.correct: The Lord who created heaven and earth
reading.explain: The blessing is invoked from 'Господь, сотворивший небо и землю' (the Lord who made heaven and earth).

reading.question: What is the main action required?
reading.explain: The psalm begins with the imperative 'Благословите Господа' (Bless the Lord).

reading.question: When and where are these servants standing?
options: At night in the house of the Lord
During the day in the temple
reading.correct: At night in the house of the Lord
reading.explain: The text specifies they are 'стоящие ночью в доме Господнем' (standing at night in the house of the Lord).

reading.ru: Господь, сотворивший небо и землю, да благословит тебя Сиона.
reading.question: From where does the blessing come?
reading.explain: The psalm concludes that the blessing comes 'от Сиона' (from Zion), where the Lord's dwelling is established.
